questions.stem: How does Concept Drift differ from Data Drift?
options: In Concept Drift the data changes within the same elements; in Data Drift the elements change
In Data Drift the data changes within the same elements; in Concept Drift the data elements themselves change
Concept Drift applies to OLTP and Data Drift to OLAP
Concept Drift is expected while Data Drift is unexpected
questions.explanation: In Data Drift the data elements do not change, only the data; in Concept Drift the data elements themselves change.

questions.stem: By which other names is Concept Drift known?
options: Class drift, real concept drift or posterior probability shift
Covariate shift, virtual drift or virtual concept drift
questions.explanation: Concept Drift is also known as class drift, real concept drift or posterior probability shift.

questions.stem: Is Concept Drift an expected or unexpected behaviour in data?
questions.explanation: Concept Drift is mostly unexpected behaviour in data, unlike Data Drift, which is one of the most expected.

questions.stem: In the cold drinks example, what event constitutes the Concept Drift?
options: Five new drink flavours being added
A sudden change in weather, with a week of rain and an unexpected temperature drop
questions.explanation: Buying behaviour depended on hot weather; a sudden rainy week and temperature drop changed the underlying concept, so the model's behaviour was impacted.

questions.stem: In the cold drinks example, what fraction of the planned 1M weekly production do people consume after the weather changes?
questions.explanation: Due to the pleasant weather people consume only 25% of the 1M cold drinks, so the model must quickly change its training data.

questions.stem: What must a machine learning model do after Concept Drift is detected?
options: Switch to a different query language
Quickly change its training data and predict the new production behaviour
questions.explanation: After Concept Drift the model must quickly change its training data and re-predict, since the whole model's behaviour is impacted.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the listed types of Concept Drift?
questions.explanation: The listed types are Sudden, Gradual, Incremental and Reoccurring Drift; covariate shift is another name for Data Drift.

questions.stem: What is the consequence of Concept Drift for a model's output?
options: The model totally fails to produce or predict the planned output
The model's data elements are deleted
questions.explanation: After Concept Drift the model will totally not produce or predict the output that was planned, and wrong prediction means wrong decisions.

questions.stem: In the cold drinks example, on which external factor does buying behaviour depend?
questions.explanation: Buying behaviour of the cold drinks depends on external factors like weather, which is expected to be hot in the region.

questions.stem: Which pair of performances is compared when Concept Drift is evaluated?
options: Tested versus actual performance of machine learning models
questions.explanation: Concept Drift is referred to in Data Science practice to evaluate tested versus actual performance of ML models.
